load_checkpoint_into_model: load a checkpoint file into a PyTorch model stripping module and backbone prefixes
get_state_dict_from_file: get the state_dict from a checkpoint file with prefix stripping for backbone models
load_checkpoint_strict_mode: load a checkpoint into a model with strict matching of parameter names
load_checkpoint_with_logger: load a checkpoint into a model using a custom logger for error messages
get_state_dict_map_location: get the state_dict from a checkpoint file mapping tensors to a specified device
